✨ HuggingFaceModelDownloader | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Downloading models and datasets from HuggingFace Hub, with a focus on efficient, parallel downloads and intelligent selection of model quantizations.
✨ Key Features: • Parallel downloads (multiple connections per file, concurrent file downloads) • Interactive GGUF picker with quality ratings and RAM estimates • Automatic resume on interruption • Python compatibility (integrates with HuggingFace cache)
📖 Summary: HuggingFaceModelDownloader is a Go utility designed for efficiently downloading models and datasets from the HuggingFace Hub. It offers parallel download capabilities, an interactive GGUF analyzer for selecting model quantizations, and seamless integration with Python's HuggingFace libraries.
